name: com.amaan.googlesheetsfetcher
description: A modular, UniTask-powered Google Sheets fetching and syncing toolkit for Unity supporting Public URLs, Google API Keys, Apps Script Secret URLs, batch downloading, reusable generic SheetSyncEditor<T>, and a zero-dependency [TableView] inspector attribute.

samples.description: Sample GoogleSheetsRegistrySO and SampleSheetDataSO with SheetSyncEditor and [TableView].
